scope: Labelled origin supplements for November calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 11-01 11-31 listed reviewed November histories without origin wording; r161-data.mjs + build-r161.mjs (generated by makebuild.mjs from the round 151 helpers and the O-blocks of rounds 152–161) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r161.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Lithuanian comparison names in two-stem notes are checked against the LT calendar (lt2check.cjs). Skipped: names whose reviewed history already explains the word (Šarlote, Leonards, Kaija, Kaira, Kajs, Kornēlija, Konrāds, the explained Lithuanian two-stem names, Vakarė, Ilo, Helmo), names without a secure base (Venda, Vega, Nele, Anda, Ziga, Karina, Gedilė, Svirbutas, Kolumbanas, Tiia, Vaho group) and recent EE register names. Rounds 159–162 share writer 1.9.132 and the audit research/namedays/round162-audit.json. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
